name: Intelligence Briefings
description: AI-written summaries of key interviews, keynotes and hearings with leaders in tech, AI, finance and policy, published daily. Every summary links its source YouTube video.
notes: Summaries are generated by an LLM from the video transcripts and can contain errors: cite and check the source video for anything that matters. Transcripts are not redistributed here.

People and organizations are indexed from who SPEAKS in each video (name and role as tagged by an LLM; the organization is the employer in that role, sometimes a former one). A company that is discussed but not represented by a speaker has no entry of its own: filter catalog.json or the day files by keyword to find it.
